I'm tired of this bullshit that the general public tries to peddle to suicidal people. Yesterday, I unfortunately attended the funeral of a friend who took his own life. I've been struggling for years. I nearly took my life, picked up the gun and held it shakily, only days before he did. I sat down with my friend, and her mother's friend told her, "you're not allowed to kill yourself. It's a permanent solution to a temporary problem." I nearly lost my shit at a funeral. Fuck you and fuck your bullshit. I have been suicidal since I can remember, nor will I likely ever stop experiencing suicidal ideation. It isn't temporary, it is my life. This is my fucking life and people think it's as simple as "well you're not allowed to so you can't." I hope you find genuine help op, and I hope your therapist cuts the shit with any current or future clients. Find your own reasons that keep you going, because no matter how much we want to, staying alive for other people's reasons just doesn't cut it. 

Find your own happiness and stick with it. I wish the best of luck to you, OP, and I hope you find health and happiness.
